intro: Small room and big dreams? Opal is here to make the most of your space without compromising style or comfort. Its airy design and sturdy build make even the smallest rooms feel bigger and brighter.

features.title: Spacious and breathable design for a fresh feel
features.text: Its sleek, open design creates an illusion of space, adding lightness and sophistication to your compact room.

features.title: Perfect fit, perfect function
features.text: Tailored for smaller rooms, this bed offers a comfortable sleeping solution while optimising space, making it ideal for urban living.

features.title: Knock-down construction for easy setup
features.text: Assemble and disassemble with ease. The knock-down design ensures effortless portability and flexibility for rearranging your space.

features.title: Sturdy metal frame for long-lasting durability
features.text: Crafted with a strong metal frame, the bed guarantees years of reliable support, combining functionality with lasting style.

features.title: Easy maintenance for everyday living
features.text: Designed for hassle-free care, its smooth surfaces and durable materials make cleaning quick and effortless, keeping your room fresh and inviting.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
